question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We will complete the project __________ without external help.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ourselves**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**ourselves**" is a reflexive pronoun used to indicate that the subject and the object of the verb are the same group. (हम स्‍वयं)
 
• The use of "**ourselves**" emphasizes that the project will be completed by the group without any external help.
 
• The other options: "**oneself**," "**itself**," and "**themselves**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We will complete the project ourselves__ without external help.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oneself (स्वयं)**: refers to a person’s own self and is typically used in a singular context.
 
• **Itself (स्वयं)**: refers to a thing's own self and is used for non-living things or animals in a singular context.
 
• **Themselves (खुद)**: is a reflexive pronoun used for referring to a group of people or things previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.
